regions.region: page 1 title, graphical abstract, abstract, author block, and keywords
regions.finding: Verified the article title and the generic current CuI/(R,Sa)-N-PINAP EATA reaction class with two ordered temperature stages, aggregate 40–73% yield, up to 95% ee, and 12 examples. This is a general scheme rather than one experiment.

regions.region: page 1 left-column introduction and prior-work narrative
regions.finding: The 2012 CuBr/N-PINAP then ZnI2/NaI process and 2015 CuBr/N-PINAP/CdI2 one-pot process are explicitly previous work. They are classified as two literature examples and not counted as current-paper experiments.

The narrative maps to the eight Table 1 rows on page 2. The azocane run gives 3aa 76%, propargylic amine 12%, and 86% ee and is the same run later listed as Table 2 entry 1; it is merged across tables.

unresolved: The graphical abstract has generic R groups and aggregate outcomes only.
Prior-work stage times, scales, yields, and some identities are not specified here.
No Supporting Information association was inferred.

regions.finding: Visually separated the two cited previous routes from the lower generic current reaction. All explicit catalyst/ligand/salt loadings, temperatures, molecular sieves, filtration, and ordered stages were retained without assigning current-paper yields to the old routes.

regions.region: page 2 center Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–8, and footnotes
regions.finding: Eight independent amine-screen conditions were retained with row amine identity, first-stage time, fixed 130 °C/5 h second stage, product/intermediate NMR yields, ee or not-determined result, CH2Br2 basis, and isolated-product chiral-HPLC basis. Entry 7 is merged with Table 2 entry 1.

The prose introduces Table 2 and states the optimized entry-4 mixture was stirred in toluene, whereas Table 2 specifies 1,4-dioxane. Both solvent statements are preserved as an unresolved source conflict.

unresolved: Table 1 header/drawing stereochemical shorthand for propargylic amine 4 is inconsistent with footnote 8.
Optimized-condition solvent conflict: prose says toluene while Table 2 entry 4 says 1,4-dioxane.
Most screening/optimization rows omit workup and isolated masses.

regions.region: page 3 upper Table 2 reaction header, entries 1–13, and footnotes
regions.finding: Thirteen optimization conditions were retained row by row, including CuI/N-PINAP loadings, solvent, 0.5 h room-temperature first stage, row-specific second-stage time, the entry-7 120 °C override, two product-specific NMR yields, ee, and the entry-13 not-determined marker. Entry 1 is the merged Table 1 entry-7 run.

The prose introduces ten Table 3 scope rows and two out-of-table 1e/1f experiments. These are linked to page-4 rows/arrows rather than duplicated; the 1f 69% assignment remains ambiguous between the two displayed diastereomers.

The text proposes alkynyl-Cu species 5, iminium 6, propargylic amine 4, complex 7, anti-1,5-hydride transfer, and anti-beta-elimination. These are represented as one mechanism record, not preparations.

unresolved: Most table yields lack an explicit isolated/NMR basis on pages 3–4.
The Scheme 2 69% yield assignment is not unambiguous.
Proposed intermediates are not independently observed.

regions.region: page 4 upper Table 3 reaction header, entries 1–10, and footnotes
regions.finding: Ten distinct substrate-scope experiments were retained with Condition A/B ligand identity, scale, equivalents/loadings, 8 mL dioxane, two ordered temperature stages, row-specific 24 h/48 h first-stage overrides, yield, and ee. Reproduction acknowledgments for entries 5/6/8 were attached as provenance without duplicate runs.
The 1e/cyclohexanecarbaldehyde experiment gives (S)-3ea in 52% and 60% ee under the displayed two-stage conditions; it is independent from Table 3.

The 1f experiment displays (Sa,S)-3fa and (Sa,R)-3fa with 41/49% ee and 47/44% de beside a single 69% yield. Both products remain in one multi-product experiment and the yield assignment ambiguity is logged.
The caption says alkynes 1d/1e while drawings and prose use 1e/1f; the source conflict is retained. The acknowledgment of reproduced 3ca/3cc/3dc lacks separable run details.

unresolved: Scheme 2 caption conflicts with the substrate labels in its drawings/prose.
The 1f product-mixture yield basis and assignment are not stated unambiguously.
Reproduction acknowledgments do not identify independent runs.

regions.finding: The full catalytic-cycle/absolute-configuration drawing was inspected and classified as a proposed mechanism. Species 5–7 and the hydride-transfer/elimination arrows are not independent experiments.
The article states that Supporting Information is available online, but source_mapping.json marks association unestablished; no SI file or SI-only fact was associated or inferred.
Bibliography and prior-art citations only. External papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 6 left column references and footnote 8
regions.finding: References are prior literature. Footnote 8 states that propargylic amines (R)-4 were difficult to isolate, assigned by comparison with (R)-4aa, and quantified by crude 1H NMR at approximately 3.20–2.90 ppm; this enriches Table 1/2 outcome bases without creating preparations.
